title: Lab - Multi-container Pods
description: Add a sidecar and read its logs.
scenario: Add a sidecar and read its logs. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Count
tasks.instructions: How many containers does Pod red have?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Add a sidecar
tasks.instructions: Create Pod yellow with containers lemon (busybox, sleep 1000) and gold (redis).

tasks.title: Task 3 - Ship logs
tasks.instructions: Add a sidecar to app in namespace elastic-stack that tails /log/app.log and confirm the log reaches Kibana.
tasks.solution: # sidecar kodekloud/filebeat-configured with the same volume mount
